name: Glittering Lion — loses a quoted ability until end of turn
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: loses QUOTED). '{3}: Until end of turn, this creature loses "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature."' fired to nothing. A quoted ability after 'loses' is now a REMOVE_ABILITIES naming that ability, matched with or without its final period. The activated Lion loses its prevention ability; the Lynx, not activated, keeps it.

call: Until end of turn, this creature loses "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature." Any player may activate this ability.
